summary: P09 quotes the paper densely and covers 21 of 26 sub-steps. It omits the residual table (L1), the binary nonalternating/orthonormal-basis argument (L4, only asserted), the explicit deficit values η_b and η_c (R2, R3), and the full definitions of ν, C_0 and C_1 (S1). No sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
